![India's Surat Diamond Bourse: World's new largest office ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09290840-2330-0066-0000-975c040981bf:4)
Surat , India, `cuts and polishes 9 out of every 10 diamonds on earth` , making it the global capital of the diamond manufacturing industry.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/OYvJNU0Y1zI)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i6rfU4p_5Vg)

### The Global Diamond Hub

- **Scale:** Roughly 90% of the world's cut and polished diamonds pass through Surat's workshops by volume.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DPh0CNVDvHH/)
- **Workforce:** An estimated 900,000 skilled craftspeople handle precision cutting and polishing in the city.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/i3ACADFK5jY)
- **Surat Diamond Bourse (SDB):** Located in DREAM City, this massive trade center features 4,000 luxury offices designed to centralize international banking, customs, and grading.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surat_Diamond_Bourse)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i6rfU4p_5Vg)
- **Lab-Grown Shift:** Surat rapidly dominates the synthetic gem market using chemical vapor deposition (CVD) technology, which now accounts for about half of the area's polished exports.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i6rfU4p_5Vg)

If you are looking to purchase jewelry or trade stones online, you can explore certified collections directly at [Surat Diamond](https://www.suratdiamond.com/?srsltid=AU7gw4Wh0qcpqFHlsprl7QAIQI5rXKHs28quw5SOpEHY6qFlapMlNfIe).[[1]](https://www.suratdiamond.com/)If you want to narrow this down, let me know:
